description: Check an IPv4 address against four major public DNS blocklists (Barracuda, SpamCop, SORBS, DroneBL). A listing means the IP sent spam or abuse — mail sent from it will bounce or junk across the internet. The pre-flight check before sending email from any server or relay. Use this when an agent needs to is this IP on the major email blocklists?. x402 price $0.02/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: security_dnsbl_check
title: DNS Blocklist Check
